# Since there is only one source table, no union or join is needed.
# We just need to select and convert columns to match the target schema:

# Select relevant columns

    [
        'provider_zip_code',
        'provider_id',
        'average_covered_charges',
        'average_total_payments',
        'average_medicare_payments'
    ]
].copy()

df_target['average_medicare_payments'] = df_target['average_medicare_payments'].astype(float)

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_81/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
